paragraphs: Shakfa. R' Shimon bar Shakfa — Kohelet Rabbah, beginning of chapter 11.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קה״ר רפ״י״א is expanded as Kohelet Rabbah, beginning of chapter 11. This notice’s locator is retained rather than substituting a fuller locator from another notice; no named edition is independently verified.
Shakfa is a conventional vocalization of שקפא, listed in Shimon bar Shakfa. The abbreviated title remains R'; no further biography is supplied.
